newsitem.title: GERMANY: German publishers post fewer titles, higher sales.
newsitem.headline: German publishers post fewer titles, higher sales.

text.p: The number of new books published in Germany dropped sharply in 1996 compared to the previous year but the industry still posted growth in sales, the Association of the German Book Industry said on Tuesday.

With 71,500 new titles published last year, the association said production volume sank nearly 15 percent from 1995. But with turnover of 17.2 billion marks ($9.8 billion), the industry saw its largest expansion in years, the Frankfurt-based group said.

"The drop in new titles is not a good development," said the director of the association, Gerhard Kurtze. "The business with books is becoming more transitory and requires more exertion from the publisher's side."
Yet Kurtze hailed the 4.2 percent climb in turnover in the industry last year as the strongest growth since the boost in sales from German reunification in 1990.
He said the figures showed that the book industry was doing far better than the retail business as a whole, but said business had stagnated since the early part of 1997.
Publishers taken alone reported five percent growth in turnover in 1996, in part due to the development of the the licensing business with eastern Europe, especially with Poland.
Kurtze said his association planned to promote more German books in English translation.
Although retailers as a whole posted a lower rate of growth than publishers at 3.2 percent in 1996, travel and mail-order booksellers saw a double-digit jump in turnover.
The association observed a small east-west split in book purchases in 1996, with families of four in the west spending 29.57 marks per year while eastern households spent 24.19 marks on books.

Kurtze said he expected a slight recovery for the industry in the second half of 1997, but said publishers would have to be careful with potential price increases for fear of a backlash in the highly competitive market.
The Association of the German Book Industry represents nearly 7,000 publishers and retailers. ($ = 1.752 German Marks)
